slides.needs: boxer walking to the ring, back to camera, spotlight
slides.text: 4 habits that make you dangerous in the ring...

slides.needs: boxer throwing combo on pads, blur
slides.text: Punch in combinations. Single shots are easy to read.
Finish every combo with defense. Slip, roll or step out.
Attack the body early. It brings the hands down later.

slides.needs: boxer sitting in corner, towel, calm
slides.text: Stay calm when you get hit. Panic is what gets you knocked out.
